documents.topic: rawValue → underlying rename — alignment with upstream Carrier rename
documents.statusDetail: Cohort-wide policy C1 (2026-05-09): Story 1 launches at the current rawValue shape; the rename is scheduled but unscoped for a future major version. The trivial-self-carrier shape (Affine.Discrete.Vector.Underlying = Affine.Discrete.Vector) is preserved across 0.x for cohort coherence.

Superseded 2026-05-09 by the Carrier migration; vector `.one` is now provided by the `Carrier.Protocol where Underlying == Affine.Discrete.Vector` extension and is visible at every consumer of the typed-offset surface.
